faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Cupertino homeowners typically invest $7,000 to $17,000 for a full window replacement project. This premium Silicon Valley city features a mix of 1960s–1980s ranches and newer luxury homes. Projects frequently include premium glass packages for energy efficiency and UV protection of high-value interiors. Single window installation starts at approximately $600.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Yes. Cupertino requires a building permit for window replacements, including like-for-like replacements. Our team manages all Cupertino permit applications and coordinates with the Community Development Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Cupertino's high-income demographic drives demand for premium products. We most frequently install Andersen 400-Series wood-clad for homes in established neighborhoods, Milgard Ultra fiberglass for superior energy performance, and Anlin Del Mar triple-pane for tech-forward homeowners focused on maximum efficiency and noise reduction near Apple Park.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Cupertino neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Cupertino neighborhoods including Monta Vista, Garden Gate, Seven Springs, Rancho Rinconada, and all areas adjacent to Apple Park. We cover zip codes 95014 and 95015.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Most Cupertino projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
